title: Closeout summary: S03T08 - Add closeout gate and import-export directive validation
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented closeout gate directive-link validation and preservation. Closeout gate satisfaction and forced-gate metadata now carry directiveIds and acknowledgementIds, gate views and directive snapshots preserve those links, and import/export rejects dangling gate directive references when directive bundles are present.

Close reason: Directive closeout gate and import-export validation implemented, tested, checkpointed, and strict doctor green.
